actions.name: Use
actions.area: 30-ft.-radius burst DESCRIPTION This spell functions like Slow ga , except it affects an enhanced version of the Slow status effect. Creatures in the area of effect suffer a -2 penalty on Attack rolls, -2 penalty on Reflex saves, moves at quarter movement, and can only take 1 standard action a round.
